domain_entities.name: ResourceID
attributes: prefix: string (one of the seven Prefix* constants: i, img, key, task, vpc, subnet, eni)
domain_entities.purpose: Unique identifier for cloud resources, composed of a type prefix and a random hex component. Used for resource addressing, lookup, and type identification across the platform.

business_rules: ResourcePrefix(value) returns the prefix of value if and only if HasResourceShape(prefix, value) is true for that prefix; the prefix is uniquely determined by the value and must be one of the seven declared Prefix* constants. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever ResourceID prefix extraction appears, not only here]
domain_notes: This feature adds a single pure function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) to internal/id/resource.go. It extracts the type prefix from a well-formed resource ID by reusing HasResourceShape and the seven existing Prefix* constants. No new domain entities, lifecycle states, or cross-entity business rules are introduced. The ResourceID entity already exists in the codebase with its prefix+hexPart structure. The function is a deterministic utility: given a valid resource ID, it returns the prefix; given anything else (unknown prefix, empty string, wrong length, uppercase hex), it returns ("", false). The existing lifecycle states (generated, active, terminated) apply to ResourceID instances but are not modified by this feature.
